summary: The Federal Facilities Service, Mountain Region, intends to award one firm-fixed-price contract to replace the pneumatic HVAC controls at the Ridgeview Outpatient Clinic in Ridgeview, Utah with a direct digital control system. The job is between $250,000 and $500,000 and is set aside entirely for service-disabled veteran-owned small businesses. Offers are due by email by 2:00 p.m. Mountain Time on Tuesday, March 30, 2027.

notes.text: Only certified service-disabled veteran-owned small businesses can be considered. The text says offers from any other firm will not be considered, so a firm without that certification cannot bid this as the prime.

The bid guarantee is stated as 20 percent of the offered price. That is what the text says, and it is an unusually large amount. Offers must also be sent by email, and the text does not say how or in what form the guarantee is to be delivered. Confirm both with the Contracting Officer.

The deadline for questions (Tuesday, March 16, 2027 at 4:00 p.m. Mountain Time) appears under the site visit heading, not with the offer instructions, and is easy to miss. The text does not say how or to whom questions are sent.

There is one site visit, on Thursday, March 11, 2027 at 9:00 a.m. The text says offerors are "urged to attend", which I read as not mandatory. It does not say where to meet, and the time is given without a time zone while the other deadlines say Mountain Time.
Performance and payment bonds are required within ten days of award, but the amount is not stated. No state contractor licence is named anywhere in the text.
